weblings.name: Sentry
weblings.purpose: Detect unusual administrator gate, session, and access-state evidence.

weblings.name: Ledger
weblings.purpose: Verify assessment, record, review, and credential-handoff integrity.

weblings.name: Weaver
weblings.purpose: Detect expected-state drift in configuration, repositories, and approved routing references.

weblings.name: Hashling
weblings.purpose: Check hashes, manifests, component versions, and integrity claims.

weblings.name: Vaultling
weblings.purpose: Detect evidence that secrets or key material have crossed an approved custody boundary.

weblings.name: Quill
weblings.purpose: Check administrative audit/worklog continuity and unexplained change evidence.

weblings.name: Beacon
weblings.purpose: Assess backup, recovery, continuity, and known-good readiness evidence.
